rationale: TRAP2 driver is Fos2A-iCreER (JAX 030323), so the Fos locus IS the driver. A Fos probe reports the endogenous transcript and confirms that the cells you tagged were Fos+ at the time of 4-OHT. Peak mRNA 30-60 min after stimulus.
source: Guenthner 2013 Neuron (TRAP); Allen 2017 Science (TRAP2); DeNardo 2019 Nat Neurosci

rationale: Only IEG that is strictly neuron-specific and induced by neuronal activity rather than by growth factors or stress, so it is the cleanest control that your Fos signal is activity-driven and not artifactual.
Dendritically-localised IEG, standard second activity marker alongside Fos. Fos+/Arc+ double-positive cells are the high-confidence activated set.
Heterodimerises with Fos to form AP-1. Confirms a functional AP-1 response rather than Fos mRNA alone.
Acute FosB plus the stable DeltaFosB isoform. Useful if any part of the paradigm is repeated or chronic (e.g. repeated drug or behaviour sessions).
Widely used alternative activity marker with slightly different induction kinetics from Fos; helps time-resolve the activation window.
Calcium/cAMP-responsive IEG. Adds dynamic range when Fos saturates.
Optional extra AP-1-independent activity readout.
Optional AP-1 partner; less dynamic than Junb.
Late-response gene (peaks 2-6 h). Distinguishes cells that were transiently active from cells that engaged plasticity programmes - relevant because 4-OHT TRAP labelling integrates over hours.
Activity-induced short isoform Homer1a; optional plasticity readout.
Activity-regulated secretogranin; optional.

The permanent TRAP tag. Ai14 (JAX 007914) / Ai9 (JAX 007909) express CAG-LSL-tdTomato after Cre recombination. NOT a mouse gene - Xenium/other panels need a CUSTOM probe against the tdTomato ORF. This is the probe that tells you which cell was TRAPped.

Probe against the codon-improved Cre (iCreER) sequence in Fos2A-iCreER. Confirms the driver is expressed in the cell and separates driver-expressing from reporter-expressing cells (recombination failures). CUSTOM probe required.
Only needed if you use a GFP-based reporter (Ai48/Ai82) or Fos-shEGFP mice instead of tdTomato. CUSTOM probe required.
Woodchuck response element is present in many reporter/AAV cassettes. A single WPRE probe catches several constructs at once, useful if you also inject AAVs. CUSTOM probe required.
Cortical/pallial excitatory backbone. Required in ORBm (all IT/ET/CT/NP) and to identify the 012 MEA Slc17a7 Glut population in BMAp.
Subcortical excitatory backbone. Required for the BMAp VGLUT2-like populations (113 / 119 / 120 / 121) and for ORBm 032 L5 NP.
Inhibitory backbone; needed to gate the BMAp sAMY-like neighbour controls and the ORBm interneurons.
Second inhibitory backbone marker; Gad1+Gad2 together are more robust than either alone.
Confirms vesicular GABA release; use with Gad1/Gad2.
Optional pan-neuronal denominator for normalising activity fractions (what proportion of neurons were TRAPped).
